# Wray Automotive

> Auto repair, maintenance & towing based in Bloomington, Indiana. Bloomington's no-upsell repair shop. We tell you what your car needs now, what can wait, and what it costs before we start. Broke down? Our own trucks tow it in.

- Phone: (812) 369-4520
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Service area: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Martinsville, Spencer, Nashville
- Google rating: 4.8 from 456 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/indiana/wray-automotive/quote.html
- Book a drop-off: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/indiana/wray-automotive/book.html

## Services
- Diagnostics & repair: Warning light, strange noise, burning smell? We find the real problem and explain it in plain terms before anything gets replaced.
- Brakes: An authorized PowerStop installation center. Squeals, shakes or a soft pedal get a proper look and a fair quote.
- Oil changes & maintenance: AMSOIL and Castrol on the shelf, Hunter tire equipment in the bay, and an honest look-over while your car is in.
- Towing & roadside: Our own Wray flatbeds and wrecker. Broke down on a Sunday night? Call and we'll get the car to the shop.
- Students' & older cars: IU parents trust us with their kids' cars. We explain what matters, what can wait, and keep you in the loop from miles away.
- Classics & performance: Hot rods, a '55 Chevy pickup, Corvettes, Vipers and AMGs all turn up in our lot. Bring the fun car in with the daily driver.

## About
Wray Automotive is a family-run repair shop at 1109 N Jackson St #1 in Bloomington. Look for the brown steel building with five bay doors and orange bollards, the black sign with the piston, crossed wrenches and orange WRAY plate, and the blue awning over the office door. We are ASE certified with over twenty years of experience, and we work on just about anything: daily drivers, Subarus, students' hand-me-downs, work trucks, hot rods and performance cars. Our own flatbeds and wrecker run 24-hour towing, so a breakdown can come straight into our bays. When you call, you will usually talk with Dalton or Chris. Customers come back for the same reasons: we tell you exactly what your car needs and nothing more, we explain what can wait, and when we find the same quality part for less, the bill comes in under the estimate. Nextdoor neighbors named us a Neighborhood Favorite in 2024.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I get my car looked at?
  A: Call (812) 369-4520 or send a service request online, then bring the car to 1109 N Jackson St #1. We call you with what we find and the cost before any work starts.
- Q: Will you tell me what can wait?
  A: Yes. We explain what needs fixing now and what you can put off, so you can plan around your budget.
- Q: Will the final bill match the quote?
  A: You get a fair quote up front. Customers have had the bill come in under the estimate when we found the same quality part at a better price.
- Q: Do you tow?
  A: Yes. We run our own flatbeds and a wrecker with 24-hour service. Call (812) 369-4520 and we will bring the car straight to the shop.
- Q: My student at IU needs a mechanic. Can you help?
  A: Yes, we see a lot of IU students. We explain the problem to them, call parents with the plan if you like, and keep everyone updated until the car is ready.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 1109 N Jackson St #1, Bloomington, IN 47404. Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
